items.text: Top Gun is great but top dogs are better. Congrats to Katie, a local service dog, and her owner Scott for coming to our community’s rescue and making over 400 service visits to our local hospitals! https://t.co/d7SbleDmtp

I’m pleased to announce that with the passage of my provision in WRDA 2022, the SCV will gain access to a new source of funding to improve water infrastructure and treatment technology.

Read more:
https://t.co/2tCP2hWQ7q

Congratulations to Restore Hyper Wellness in Santa Clarita on their grand opening! They offer various services to support all health and wellness goals. Best of luck in the future! https://t.co/PJfXeIw0FI

I welcomed @ThermalHorizons, a new yoga & wellness center, to Santa Clarita. Opening a small business is no easy task and I wish owner Jaime Annett much success in this endeavor. https://t.co/xtUj661AW1

Veterans deserve top notch health care. I’m pleased that Congress finally passed the PACT Act, which will improve accessibility and coverage for servicemembers affected by toxic burn pits. I'll always stand to assist our vets.

Happy to announce that @FEMA is reimbursing Simi Valley $1.6 million for costs incurred during the COVID-19 pandemic. It is critical that hospitals in the district are fully reimbursed for the vital work they performed during the pandemic, and I will continue to fight for them.

I met w/ John to learn about LifeScore, a suicide prevention tool that evaluates soldiers’ mental health & is especially helpful pre- & post-deployment. This critical tool assists servicemembers by quickly connecting them w/ resources, ultimately impacting our military readiness. https://t.co/OtSBCQuS1G

Thanks to failed far left policies, the cost of health care has increased by 28% over the last year. This record high inflationary period is not going away soon, and health care costs will keep skyrocketing if we don’t stop reckless spending.

During this record-high inflationary period, it’s crucial that Americans have access to affordable prescription medication. I’m proud to co-sponsor the Lower Costs, More Cures Act which would keep prescription meds affordable without stifling innovation for new cures.

Last month, @CBP reported over 73,000 “gotaways,” and local sheriffs are saying that there’s just more crossings and activity than there is help.

We must help our border patrol so we can put an end to this mess.
https://t.co/B2dHzjmW99

About 17 veterans die by suicide every day. Free emergency mental health care will now be provided to all veterans. This new policy will save veterans’ lives. 
https://t.co/ceW5JXkGts

This #InternationalChildhoodCancerDay, I’m praying for all families affected by cancer. I’m proud to have helped to secure funding for the @ChildrensLA Transplantation & Cellular Therapy Lab to purchase more life-saving equipment for childhood cancer patients.

My family and I have the victims and their families in our prayers. This needless violence must stop. We must work together to harden and secure our schools and improve mental health resources and care.
https://t.co/xfR7fREX6l

Team CA-27 attended the Vets 4 Veterans Community Dinner in Lancaster to honor Dennis Anderson of High Desert Medical Group as their Veteran/Volunteer of the Year. Thank you, Dennis, for your service to our nation and local communities! https://t.co/Vr5ABt9bRz

Cartels continue to adapt to their environment, like using encrypted social media apps to get fentanyl in the hands of Americans, particularly kids.

We're losing American lives to these int'l criminal organizations & we must do more to defeat them. https://t.co/kie2VlGN6f

I stopped by Moriah Medical College to welcome students & health care professionals to Santa Clarita. Our hospitals are in desperate need of more nurses & Moriah College is helping to close this critical gap as the only vocational nursing program in the SCV. Congrats on opening! https://t.co/jajLmeWAtf

Tomorrow is National Drug Take Back Day. Proper disposal of excess medication is critical in the fight against prescription medication misuse. Most #CA27 locations are collecting from 10AM to 2PM. Click below to find a location near you: https://t.co/zJ1imqRZJn

Earlier this year, @POTUS signed into law my bipartisan Military Spouse Licensing Relief Act to better support our military families.

Today, it's the reason over 250,000 active-duty military spouses who require professional credentials to work in education, medicine, real estate, and more can keep their jobs. I couldn’t be more proud to see this bill become reality, and I’ll always fight for our military heroes and their families.

https://t.co/AOWj8COb95

Today I went to Val Verde to see the situation firsthand, and I’m calling on state and local officials to pause operations at the Chiquita Canyon Landfill. This is a health concern and an operation that needs to be stopped until we fully understand it and have a path forward to end it.

Everyone impacted by this issue has my full support at the federal level as we work to mitigate the problem and find solutions.

We don’t need more studies and reports. We need action and solutions.

The situation at the Chiquita Canyon Landfill is a matter of public health, and its operations need to pause until we know it’s safe.

Our top priority needs to be the safety and security of the families impacted by this issue - full stop. https://t.co/eUIWNTsfSS

Every dollar stolen from our healthcare programs is one dollar too many. That's why I introduced the Medicare and Medicaid Fraud Prevention Act.

This bipartisan bill is a common-sense step toward better protecting your healthcare and ensuring resources are going to those who need it most. Read more here ⬇️

https://t.co/1t5Se7jch2

This week, I proudly voted to pass the FY25 Military Construction and Veterans Affairs Appropriations bill.

Simply put, this bill helps ensure we're meeting our national security needs both at home and abroad. It fully funds our veterans' healthcare and benefits, invests in military family housing, and provides critical funding to the Indo-Pacific.

I'm committed to supporting our veterans, military families, and national defense, and this bill reflects that commitment.

I'm proud to support this year's FY25 Military Construction and Veterans Affairs Appropriations bill, which today passed the House.

It fully funds the healthcare and benefits our veterans deserve, supports military families and quality of life on base, and strengthens America's defense.

I'm committed to fully supporting our veterans and troops who answered the call of duty, and I'm proud to say this bill reflects that commitment. Read more about this critical, bipartisan legislation here ⬇️

https://t.co/gL3lIxxjwI

This Medicare Fraud Prevention Week, I'd like to highlight the critical issue of fraud in our healthcare system. Every single year, taxpayers are losing more than $100 billion to fraud and abuse.

I introduced the Medicare and Medicaid Fraud Prevention Act to right this wrong. Read more about my common-sense, bipartisan bill ⬇️

https://t.co/1t5Se7jch2

Millions of Californians rely on Medicare and Medicaid, and I'll always fight to protect these critical programs. That's why I introduced a bipartisan bill to better protect your healthcare from fraud and abuse.

Taxpayers are losing more than $100 billion to healthcare fraud every year, and my common-sense bill to right that wrong is now heading to the House floor. Read more about my critical, bipartisan bill here ⬇️
